law: GIFs are earned by recurrence (house VISUALS.md). Files here are canonical; lane copies are caches. First frame doubles as the still emblem.
style: blue-ink pencil-engraving on white, ~310x414, 12 frames, loop, 0.5-1.5MB, no text

entries.motif: dog at water with its reflection
entries.depicts: A puppy at a pond edge gazing at its own reflection in still water.
entries.means: The self meeting itself; the owner smuggled into the story. Play wherever recognition misfires.
entries.use: n02 leaning-mechanics, n09 dog chapter. Never as mere cuteness.

entries.depicts: A vintage projector beaming a landscape onto a screen in a dark room.
entries.means: Consciousness as projection; the show that needs no world behind it.
entries.use: n03 cinema trick. Pairs with magician, never same span.

entries.motif: donkey chasing carrot on a stick
entries.depicts: A donkey pulling a cart, chasing a carrot dangled ahead of it.
entries.means: Goalless pursuit; the goal recedes because the chase produces it.

entries.depicts: An antique sewing machine mid-stitch, thread running.
entries.means: Stitching a self together; the final stitch never made. Closing energy.
entries.use: n10 seamstress and finale. Nowhere else.

entries.depicts: Lotus leaf beaded with rain that will not stick.
A lit oil lamp, flame leaning in dark air.
entries.means: Attention itself; the flame that goes out is also the one that sees.
entries.use: n01 fire beats, n07 exhausted-lamp chapter (counterpoint: lit vs out).

entries.depicts: Open hands letting dry sand run through.
entries.means: Release; possession failing in real time.
entries.use: n08 sandcastle chapter. Hands, never fists.

entries.depicts: A stage magician presenting a levitation, audience watching.
entries.means: The trick of consciousness; total conviction, nothing behind it.
entries.use: n09 magic-show chapter. Never alongside cinema in one span.

entries.motif: raft on water, abandon after crossing
entries.depicts: A figure on a bamboo raft, hand trailing in the water.
entries.means: The vehicle to abandon after crossing; means, not home.
entries.use: n10 raft beats. Never as travel scenery.

entries.depicts: Engraved wave gathering itself toward calm water.
entries.means: Agitation resolving without going anywhere; the whirlpool ending.
